pasterdream.entry.aaroncos_arena_world.p: Enter via the naturally generated Aaroncos Arena entrance structure in the Shadowlands biome of the Lamp & Shadow world to challenge the boss, Aaroncos' Touch.
Upon entering, you receive the No-Build and Slow Falling effects. No-Build prevents placing or breaking blocks.
pasterdream.entry.dyedream_world.page0: The first biome you step into in PasterDream — Layer 0 of the dream. No monsters spawn here; there are no traps or life-threatening dangers.$(br)This is where the story begins. You will discover new things and relics left by previous dream seekers, and read the stories they left behind.
pasterdream.entry.dyedream_world.page1: Seek the black-and-white church floating in the sky — the Dyed Church. The note inside records special coordinates in the Overworld. Head there for more information.
pasterdream.entry.dyedream_world.page2: While exploring structures, you can also find Meltdream Crystal Shards in Meltdream Crystal Chests — an important material for what comes next.
pasterdream.entry.lamp_shadow_world.page: Beneath Lamp & Shadow is the second layer of dream you enter in the PasterDream progression. Unlike the pink, monster-free Dyedream World, this world's dominant color is black with low visibility, and it naturally spawns large numbers of hostile creatures.

Numerous ruins await exploration. Gather note fragments from creatures and ruins, craft them into notes, and delve into the Shadow Dungeon to reach the next layer and uncover the secrets of PasterDream.
How to reach:$(br)After completing the 'Stronghold Guard' event inside a Twilight Cage structure, use a Twilight Long Bed to enter. You can craft your own Twilight Long Bed afterwards.

How to leave:$(br)After entering by any means, you are given a Pale Bone Needle. Use it to leave and return to the Overworld. After the third time entering the Shadow Dungeon, speak with 'The Nameless'; afterward, they will teleport you back to the Overworld.
pasterdream.entry.meltdream.page0: Certain weapon skills and the Forced Tower consume Meltdream Energy. Sneak to view your current Meltdream Energy in the bottom-left corner.
pasterdream.entry.meltdream.page1: You can restore Meltdream Energy by wearing items like the Meltdream Halo Ring, or by consuming Dyedream Popsicles and Dyedream Juice.$(br)Additionally, opening a Meltdream Crystal Chest restores 2 Meltdream Energy.
pasterdream.entry.san.page0: Sanity (SAN) is an important player attribute that can be disabled via gamerule.$(br)When enabled, high SAN grants beneficial potion effects; low SAN causes negative effects and other drawbacks.
pasterdream.entry.san.page1: Environmental SAN changes:$(br)In the $(l:overview/dyedream_world)Dyedream World$(), SAN increases at 2.4/min.$(br)In the Overworld at dusk and night, SAN decreases at 0.48/min.$(br)In the $(l:overview/lamp_shadow_world)Lamp & Shadow World$(), SAN decreases at 1.2/min.$(br)In the $(l:overview/aaroncos_arena_world)Aaroncos Arena World$(), SAN decreases at 4.8/min.
pasterdream.entry.san.page2: Ways to restore SAN: Eat specific foods (e.g., Pineapple Love Sea), equip wreaths, or sleep at night.
pasterdream.entry.san.page3: If your SAN drops too low, you may see anomalous phenomena. Keep an eye on it.
pasterdream.entry.wind_journey_world.pag: Wind's Journey is a parallel dream realm unrelated to Lamp & Shadow.$(br)It features many visually striking structures that are easy to explore, but you need flight or levitation to reach the Dreamcloud biome; otherwise you can only stay on the Windward Isles.

How to reach:$(br)1. Touch a Dyedream Rift and sleep to obtain and read the Dreamseeker Note [Dyedream Rift].$(br)2. Enter Dyedream via the rift and read [Dyedream World].$(br)3. Find the Windwhisper Church in Dyedream and read [Even Wingless Birds Dream of Flight].$(br)Once prerequisites are met, return to the Overworld, consume Strange Stew to gain the Dreamstate, then fly above Y=300. As you ascend you will be enveloped by clouds and teleported high into Wind's Journey.
How to leave:$(br)As your height decreases in Wind's Journey, you become shrouded in mist. Falling into the void returns you to high altitude in the Overworld.
Windrunner Crystal Ore rarely generates in the Deep Azure Rock layer of Wind's Journey. Requires at least diamond pickaxe to mine and drops 1 Windrunner Crystal (Fortune has no effect).
Condensed Windcloud Ore generates in the thick cloud layer. Can be mined by hand; using a shovel increases efficiency. Drops 1–2 Condensed Wind; affected by Fortune.

book.pasterdream.bubble_ecosphere.title: Bubble Ecosphere
book.pasterdream.bubble_ecosphere.author: Qianye
book.pasterdream.bubble_ecosphere.page.0:
Just as I was rowing a wooden boat across the ocean, searching for those ruins floating in the sky, I glanced around during a break and happened upon this wondrous sphere.
This sphere drifted in the icy seawater, with the faint silhouettes of fish visible behind its transparent membrane. I dove in, reached out a cautious hand, and tried to touch the membrane — only to pass right through after feeling a faint resistance.
Incredibly, the inside of this sphere was warm, in stark contrast to the freezing ocean water that had just soaked me to the bone—
book.pasterdream.bubble_ecosphere.page.1:
Truly, it was a stark contrast. Crouching down, I reached through the thick clouds, and sure enough, the seawater below was warm too. The tropical fish here weren't specimens, and those vivid colors I'd seen from the boat weren't hallucinations born of a mind numbed by the cold.
Taking a closer look at the inner environment, I couldn't help but recall the ecospheres I'd seen before. Was this marvelous bubble sphere built by some being beyond human intellect, or did it form naturally in this incredible world?
I have no way of knowing.
book.pasterdream.bubble_ecosphere.page.2:
But at least the little fish drifting slowly here, like all the other creatures in this world, bore me no hostility, so I could sit here and rest a while longer before swimming back to my boat.
With that thought in mind, I casually poked the bubble wall beside me with a stick — and the wall's surface rippled violently, nearly bursting, giving me quite a fright. Truly, I'd better be more careful next time. A bubble this fragile can probably only exist in the calm frozen ocean; the slightest poke could make it vanish entirely.
On the blank title line of my notebook, I wrote down—
book.pasterdream.bubble_ecosphere.page.3: —the name "Bubble Ecosphere." After all, just like a small ecosphere, it is beautiful and fragile, so it's best to disturb it as little as possible.
book.pasterdream.dream_crystal_ball.page:
When I was little, I used to fantasize about... living inside a glass ball — my very own little world!

Having your own little ecosystem is super cool, and being wrapped up in it would be even better~

As for me, I never really liked those huge, empty, cavernous houses; I prefer a little world that belongs to me alone.

Just lying here like this, cushioned by clouds, gazing through the pink glass at the sun beyond the clouds.

Mm... mm~ Let's just... take a nap like this....

Sweet dreams

By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.seeking_secrets.title: Seeking Secrets
book.pasterdream.seeking_secrets.author: Jixing
book.pasterdream.seeking_secrets.page.0:
To gather some necessary resources, I found a desert after a long journey.
Since the resources I sought were quite rare and I might have to stay here for a while, I managed to find a village on the edge of the desert and built this little cottage to live in.
Heading out to explore at sunrise and returning to this temporary shelter before sunset; chatting with the villagers to pass the time at night, or when sandstorms kept me indoors — that was my daily routine in this desert.
book.pasterdream.seeking_secrets.page.1:
Half a year passed in the blink of an eye. My daytime explorations made no progress, but my relationship with the villagers grew warmer by the day.
The adults were endlessly grateful that I protected them from monsters at night, while the children were captivated by the adventure stories I shared from my travels — little by little, the villagers began to let me in on "secrets" they had never told any other traveler:
"Our village blacksmith almost never leaves his house, so you've probably hardly seen him. They say he used to be the royal smith of a certain kingdom, and his family forged all sorts of fine weapons and armor for the royal house—
book.pasterdream.seeking_secrets.page.2:
—but after that kingdom fell, his family declined, and finally wandered here to settle down. He still doesn't seem to have accepted his situation; he built his workshop quite a distance from our village, and we don't have much to do with him day to day — only work-related exchanges... But if it's you, you should be able to get along with him..."
The villagers seemed to want me to go counsel that reclusive, fallen forging noble (though I suspect they were just hoping that, once I got on good terms with that gentleman—
book.pasterdream.seeking_secrets.page.3:
—they could have their tools repaired at a cheaper price). I paid a visit to the blacksmith's workshop, carrying the aged wine I had treasured for years.
...
Though we went through many ups and downs, we eventually became close friends. During one drinking session, I told the elderly man that I hoped his family's exquisite forging techniques would be passed down; although I had already come to understand his forging methods through our time together, I could never, no matter how I tried, forge equipment as outstanding as his.
book.pasterdream.seeking_secrets.page.4:
After a long silence, he took out paper and pen, drew a design for me, and told me: only by strictly following the layout of his workshop could one guide and concentrate some... substance? in the air to its fullest, and thus forge extraordinary, novel tools. Humbled by his generosity and trust, I left nearly all the valuables I had brought as a token of thanks, and departed with this design.
Before I knew it, it seems I have lingered in this desert for far too long...
book.pasterdream.seeking_secrets.page.5: It's time to set out on a new journey — the next time I settle down, I'll try building a workshop according to this design.
book.pasterdream.dream_church_1.title: Dream-dye Church Diary (I)
book.pasterdream.dream_church_1.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_church_1.page.0:
Dream-dye Church (I)
A record for myself and for those who come after

In this so-called "world," I actually found a colossal building floating in the sky. I'm sure I wasn't seeing things! If you in the future can read this book too...

I instinctively feel that I'm in the middle of a dream, yet everything I perceive is so real.

As I climbed up this great building, it
book.pasterdream.dream_church_1.page.1:
looked like it should be a church? But inside there was no one at all (though, really, who would live in the sky?)

The candles were still burning, as if they would never go out. Sunlight streamed through the glass opposite the church's entrance, filling everything within.

Above the altar floated a beautiful crystal, gently drifting as it radiated light in all directions... (I stared at it for a long time back then)
book.pasterdream.dream_church_1.page.2:
I reached my hand toward the crystal, and it suddenly seemed to sense my presence — it snapped shut and dropped to the ground. (Of course I'd take such a fine treasure with me, but perhaps it will regenerate by the time you come? Maybe...)

Cradling the crystal in my palms, it seemed to be speaking to me... wishes from the depths of other souls' hearts.

Facing the great window at the back of the church, I closed my eyes and made a wish of my own...
book.pasterdream.dream_church_1.page.3:
Oh right, one more thing — I'm leaving this book right here!

As for why... I just want my story to remain in this world forever, hehe~

By: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.title: Dream-dye Lecture Hall (II)
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.author: Yelan
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.page.0:
Just the day before yesterday, Qin Yumeng suddenly told me a secret — she said she had entered a place like a dream, and insisted over and over that it was real?

At first I didn't believe her, but she kept insisting that I follow her to that magical place for an adventure, to make a wish at that so-called church together.
I turned her down several times, but in the end I decided to go with her and see for myself what this world she spoke of and that miraculous church were really like.
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.page.1:
After I stepped through that astonishing rift and saw the scene before me, I even pinched my arm... Could all this really be real?

I followed her to the church — blue soul lanterns and towering spires, a prickly-spired Western-style building. It was hard to imagine why this place bore traces of human habitation.

I decided to climb the floating island that carried this church and investigate.
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.page.2:
Inside the church, lit candles floated in the air, and glowing lanterns stood beside the pews, making the place feel even more mysterious and unreal. I wasn't sure whether any of it held meaning, but I decided to record it all.

I wandered through the church for a long time, soaking in the atmosphere. It was filled with a sense of mystery and wonder. I can't explain why I felt this way, but I knew some wondrous power dwelled here.
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.page.3:
Holding her hand, I explored every corner of the church, when suddenly she cried out, "Ouch!" — "Why are you dragging me into a wall?!" Then she stopped abruptly and stared at me in bewilderment.

"You... why are you inside this wall? Are you okay?" What wall? I couldn't make heads or tails of what she was saying.
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.page.4:
She suddenly started tugging me in circles along the wall, and then, before I knew it, I ran into something too — this time... she was the one standing inside the wall...

She then began describing this church's appearance to me in minute detail — the lecture hall she spoke of had no lanterns, nor any huge floor-to-ceiling windows.

We discussed it at length. "Could it be that what we see is different? And not just visually?" she said to me.
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.page.5:
And when I looked at the mysterious crystal floating above the prayer table beneath the church's great floor-to-ceiling window, I felt, somehow, that it was the cause of it all.

Qin Yumeng stroked the crystal with practiced ease, and it naturally floated along, following the palm of her hand.

"Qin Yumeng..." "Hmm? What is it?" "Ah, nothing..."
book.pasterdream.dream_church_2.page.6:
I've decided to write all my experiences here into a book and leave it in the church, for those who come to this place later.

That way, when my book is discovered, perhaps...

By Yelan
book.pasterdream.dream_church_3.title: Dream-dye Church (III)
book.pasterdream.dream_church_3.author: Calle
book.pasterdream.dream_church_3.page.0:
"Is this place... a little too perfect? Yinuo"

Not long after entering here, such a thought suddenly crossed my mind. Yinuo said I was overthinking it — indeed, there were no monsters here, and every corner brimmed with life and vitality.

But when I tried divination, the three results all came out different, meaning the sight before my eyes was not the true sight.
book.pasterdream.dream_church_3.page.1:
"Where there is light, there is darkness; the stronger the light, the thicker the darkness."

After half a year of ceaseless exploration in the dream, I finally discovered this... a church stained black on one side.

This jarring blackness appeared where it had absolutely no right to be. Suppressing my trembling body with all my might, I stepped into this church.

By Calle
book.pasterdream.dream_drifting.title: Drifting Through Dreams
book.pasterdream.dream_drifting.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_drifting.page.0:
Drifting Through Dreams

In the ocean of dreams, I drift, alone and unmoored

Like a lonely traveler, seeking unknown wonders.

The starry sky for company, the earth for a bed

In this land of slumber, I dance with dreams

Mist beneath my feet, the unknown up ahead
book.pasterdream.dream_drifting.page.1:
With all my heart, I feel the rhythm of every journey.

There are songs in the wind, and stories in the rain

Every single moment is a miracle of dreams.

I am a drifting traveler, fearless and unafraid

In the depths of dreams, I seek the true meaning of life.
book.pasterdream.dream_drifting.page.2:
Only so that

On this endless journey, I might become my own legend.


By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.wishing_tree.title: The Wishing Tree
book.pasterdream.wishing_tree.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.wishing_tree.page.0:
This is a wishing tree!

Well... as for why I say it's a wishing tree... to be honest, I don't really know either.

It's like coming to this place — I seemed to already know, by instinct, what to call every plant and tree here.

I can call them all by name, simply by following my heart, even though there was never any right answer to begin with.
book.pasterdream.wishing_tree.page.1:
Now, besides the wishes I usually make on birthdays... I also want to know the truth about this dream.

But it seems that on this one point alone, the tree gives no response — I can't sense anything either.

If you who come later have the answer... please continue this note.

By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_3.title: Dream-Dye Travels, Vol. III
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_3.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_3.page.0:
Dream-Dye Travels, Vol. III

Exploring here puts me at ease — even doing nothing at all can brighten my mood a little.

After all this time exploring, I've discovered four biomes in total: two temperate and two cold.

Believe it or not, coral grows beneath the icy ocean.
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_3.page.1:
It seems a train passes by every now and then — I'm not sure whether it's just my imagination.

I also rummaged through the chests of some ruins and dug up a few pleasant music discs.

The more a Dream-melt Crystal Chest vibrates, the better the treasure inside it turns out to be.

Some churches stand out from the rest, as if half of the building had been invaded by something.
book.pasterdream.dream_laboratory.title: The Dream-Dye Laboratory
book.pasterdream.dream_laboratory.author: Huixing
book.pasterdream.dream_laboratory.page.0:
A ruined building — here in this dream, I've found traces left behind by those who came before.

I'm not the only one who has discovered this strange, pink-filled place. I called out loudly, but no one answered — the people are long gone.

Dim lamplight veils the space inside the ruins, and at its center stands a trapezoid-shaped instrument of unknown purpose.
book.pasterdream.dream_laboratory.page.1:
I'm certain this place is the laboratory of a predecessor who arrived here much earlier, and what sits at its center is their final labor of love.

What a pity that I couldn't discover why they left here in such a hurry.

Now, I should carry on their research, taking this damaged instrument with me.
book.pasterdream.warm_cold_wind.title: The Warm "Cold Wind"
book.pasterdream.warm_cold_wind.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.warm_cold_wind.page.0:
Cold or warm?
The purpose of this pretty little pavilion doesn't seem to be escaping the summer heat.

The temperature here is always comfortable — even in the Frozen Ocean, it's only the surrounding glaciers that make things look "cold."

Because beneath those glaciers, tropical coral actually grows, and there are even adorable dolphins.

Hmm... maybe physics just can't explain this?
Or is it some kind of geographic wonder?
book.pasterdream.warm_cold_wind.page.1:
These pavilions also differ in color — in temperate zones the rooftops are pink, while in cold zones they're blue.
(Quite fitting for the local character~)

The undergrounds of temperate and cold zones differ as well, with different crystal formations growing in each. Perhaps these crystals will prove useful to us...

by Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.daedalus_wings.title: Daedalus's Wings and the Floating Island
book.pasterdream.daedalus_wings.author: Jixing
book.pasterdream.daedalus_wings.page.0:
Daedalus's Wings and the Floating Island

Not long after I left that towering tree in disappointment, Qianye caught up with me, interrupting my plan to start exploring anew.

"See those islands floating in mid-air? I want to go up there and see if there's any treasure." I suggested to Qianye.

To my surprise, Qianye poured cold water right on me: "You've lost it. We can't fly — how are we supposed to get up there?"
book.pasterdream.daedalus_wings.page.1:
"About that... I have a bold idea..."

Under Qianye's disbelieving gaze, I took out the feathers dropped by those pink chickens we'd picked up along the way. Then I melted the candles I'd found earlier back into wax and glued the feathers together with it — after no small amount of effort, I managed to craft two pairs of wings."

"So you want to be Icarus."
book.pasterdream.daedalus_wings.page.2:
"No, I think I'll be Daedalus. After all, the sun here won't melt this wax. And how would we know without trying? Besides..."

Things went extraordinarily smoothly — although by all logic, a person can't fly with wings like these; but for some reason, the wind here seemed to carry the wings, letting us fly without the slightest effort. We easily soared up to the floating island that I'd previously only been able to gaze up at.
book.pasterdream.daedalus_wings.page.3:
After we arrived on the island, Qianye dashed straight into that little house. I followed right behind, found a spot to sit down, and started chatting with her.

"By the way, this world is just way too far beyond common sense, isn't it?" Qianye took off her pair of wings and began inspecting whether they'd fallen apart.

"That's what I've been saying — this world must belong to some kind of dream or illusion, don't you think?"
book.pasterdream.daedalus_wings.page.4:
"After all, I simply can't understand how this island manages to float in the air safe and sound, and stays perfectly still even when we step on it."

"And this house too — even though it clearly looks man-made, there's no trace of anyone ever living here. Besides, I still can't figure out how this thing is even supposed to work." Qianye shook the wings in her hand as she spoke.

"Don't take it so seriously — in a dream, anything is possible."
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_1.title: Dream-Dye Travels, Vol. I
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_1.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_1.page.0:
Dream-Dye Travels, Vol. I

A kind of pink crystal sprout grows underground in warm regions.

Those slime-like creatures are born with natural protective coloration — perhaps they can be found by listening for their sounds.

The oceans here also hide secret treasures.

Most of the chests are hidden away, so maybe it's the same here?
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_1.page.1:
Some strange flower beds offer unique blossoms to those who can solve their puzzles.

Luck is the key to finding treasure here.

Underground caves may hide crystals that can increase your vitality.

There's a special spring here.

And inside the World Tree, treasure lies hidden... and...
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_1.page.2:
Everything I've seen here feels strangely familiar... as if I've lived through it all before..  every bit of its existence.

By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_2.title: Dream-Dye Travels, Vol. II
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_2.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_2.page.0:
Dream-Dye Travels, Vol. II

In the shallow underground here, there's an edible ore — and it's sweet, too.

You can also find rare titanium metal, though since its color blends in with the environment, we don't spot it easily.

A fruit grows on the leaves of Dream-dyed trees — you can turn this fruit into a cake.

Some native crops need a special soft-mud fertilizer to ripen quickly.
book.pasterdream.dream_travels_2.page.1:
Grinding Dream-dye dust together with bone meal can produce a special dye.

The pink quartz mineral that grows underground is a fine building material!

In some underground research lab, there's a machine that can accumulate Dream-dye dust.

By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.dream_worldtree.title: The Dream-Dyed World Tree
book.pasterdream.dream_worldtree.author: Jixing
book.pasterdream.dream_worldtree.page.0:
While gazing at the scenery by chance, I spotted this towering giant of a tree at the edge of my sight. Walking to its base and looking up, its trunk rises into the clouds — I could hardly even see its branches and leaves.

Digging through the soil around its roots, I found that they don't extend very far, which seems hard to explain given its abnormal height.

The winding trunk forms a natural staircase, though in some places I still had to climb on my own. Reaching the very top of the branches, I could see a small hollow within.
book.pasterdream.dream_worldtree.page.1:
A glowing white spring flows from the side of the trunk, and every part of it seems abnormal — though compared with this world itself, such a sight was hardly enough to surprise me anymore.

Back at the base of the tree, I began to ponder how this tree came to be and grew so well. In response, I formed a hypothesis:

This world belongs to some kind of dream, and the dream energy in its atmosphere is unevenly distributed.
book.pasterdream.dream_worldtree.page.2:
Just as atmospheric phenomena cause changes in weather, this energy dissolved in the dream's atmosphere — Dream-melt energy — should likewise be unevenly distributed.

In regions where Dream-melt energy settles more heavily, the energy condenses into physical form, giving rise to continents, floating islands, trees, and everything else in this world. And where Dream-melt energy gathers in great quantities within a small area, the result is a Dream-melt Crystal Chest — which also explains why Dream-melt energy leaks out when a chest is opened.
book.pasterdream.dream_worldtree.page.3:
Extrapolating from this theory, at the center of this dream world — where Dream-melt energy is most concentrated — some kind of enormous structure should have formed; and the abundant Dream-melt energy would have crystallized into a great number of Dream-melt Crystal Chests stored within it.

At that thought, I turned to look back in the direction of the giant tree. It may well be the World Tree of this dream world — a gathering place of Dream-melt energy, a dreamlike land filled with Dream-melt Crystal Chests.
book.pasterdream.dream_worldtree.page.4:
I ought to climb this tree once more and investigate its inner structure. Finding nothing last time must mean I missed something...


By  Jixing
book.pasterdream.falling_leaves.title: Falling Leaves Return to Their Roots, Burst Pods Return to Their Crown
book.pasterdream.falling_leaves.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.falling_leaves.page.0:
O mighty tree in full bloom — your leaves and branches, your children, fall to rest beside your roots as they wither.

Other plants abandon their seed pods the moment they are born, casting away the last husk their mother left them.

But you, you lift your seed pods high into the sky on the branches of your crown.

You nourish them with roots and leaves, letting them bask in the highest light — the light that crowns the very peak of this world.
book.pasterdream.falling_leaves.page.1:
Even though the seed pod has long fulfilled its purpose, it uses those nutrients to build a dream of its own.

I, too, offer my wish to you  as a gift for our first meeting.


By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.garden_decryption.title: Garden Decryption
Garden Decryption

The northwest wind blows, chimes a-ringing clear

The northeast clouds hide the warm sunlight dear

The southwest rays flow in the dusk's last light

The southeast parasols stand slender and bright

Low grass leans on blooms by the breezy strand

Enchanted by the lotus of the dream-melted land
book.pasterdream.windbreaking_knight.pag:
Ruins of ancient Greek-style architecture formed a circular temple, at whose center an unremarkable altar was enshrined.

Was it built to pray for rain? To follow the direction of the wind? Or to honor a guardian god?

I crouched beside the slab-like altar at the center and found a dark hole in its middle, with a rolled-up slip of paper standing upright inside.

It bore some hastily sketched patterns, along with a numbered sequence. A blue crystal, and three suits of armor made of something like metal.

And at the very bottom of the paper was written

"The Wind-Splitting Knight" will drive away everything except what it guards...


By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.meltdream_well.title: The Meltdream Spring Well
book.pasterdream.meltdream_well.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.meltdream_well.page.0:
So you found this out too, huh? Then let me start from the very beginning.

When I first strolled over here, the vegetation grew differently from anywhere else.

On a fairly small patch of land grew many kinds of plants, and they grew unusually densely.

Compared with other places, it was indeed quite suspicious, so I bent down to study the soil.
book.pasterdream.meltdream_well.page.1:
The surface layer looked no different, but the deeper we dug, the more we noticed that when you scoop up a handful of dirt, tiny glowing specks trickle down between your fingers.

And then, of course, I went to round up some help. I went home, brought Yelan along, and took two handy shovels plus her treasured titanium pickaxe.

As we dug deeper, more and more tiny specks of light gradually appeared in the soil.
book.pasterdream.meltdream_well.page.2:
We set up a ladder and climbed down. In a cave lush with vegetation, a glowing spring was gushing forth—perhaps this luminous spring is the sun for all those underground plants.

But scientifically speaking, no infinite source of energy can exist, so we built this "well" with the materials on hand. I brought a bottle of the spring water home, hoping my research would go smoothly.
book.pasterdream.meltdream_well.page.3:
As for the rest, I'll leave it to you who come later.

(When you draw water, remember the one who dug the well—don't forget to thank me~ hehe)

By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.pink_mushroom_house.pag:
This is my second time coming to this place—it's been over ten days since I last entered this dream.

When I got back to the waking world, I told her about this bizarre experience. But of course she didn't believe me, and even thought I'd lost my mind?

So I grabbed her by the arm and dragged her all the way here. At first she was stunned... though her ability to adapt was, as always, impressively quick.

This time we walked for a long while and found a place with a completely different biome.

Mushrooms, mushrooms, and more mushrooms—pink mushrooms.

"A mushroom this huge could even pass for a house!"

And then... a giant mushroom house really did appear right before our eyes...

It was utterly unbelievable. We stood in front of that exquisite mushroom house, stunned for several minutes.

A bedroom, a kitchen, a desk, storage chests—everything was there. There's no way nature could have crafted this.

What's strangest of all is that the house appeared out of thin air?

"Well, since it's all just a dream, this counts as totally normal? Yeah... ha... haha..." I joked.

I even surprised myself by how readily I accepted this fact... my brain was overloaded, so I just decided not to think about it!

After that, we explored the surrounding ecosystem and spent a night in this mushroom house.

As always, I'll leave this book here.

If you who come later find this, please don't eat this mushroom house! I might come back to play here someday—maybe?

By: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.shadow_hand_note.title: A Scrawled Note Stained with Shadow
book.pasterdream.shadow_hand_note.author: (name unreadable)
book.pasterdream.shadow_hand_note.page.0:
Unbelievable—I actually managed to escape from the grasp of that terrifying creature.

It was a pair of huge black hands, each palm bearing a single white eye; merely locking eyes with them made my whole body tremble, and I couldn't muster the slightest will to fight.

Even so, I forced myself to stand against it, only to find its dreadful power far exceeded my imagination.

Even the lightest attack against it drew a fierce counterattack in return.
book.pasterdream.shadow_hand_note.page.1:
I was in such a panic during the fight that I couldn't even tell which hand I was attacking.

Still, I clearly remember that attacking one hand made it sprout a spike, which it then swung around wildly;

while attacking the other hand made it unleash a spire that seemed to hold tremendous energy.

After witnessing such terrifying counterattacks, I fled in a panic—and by the end, even I had forgotten how I managed to get away.
book.pasterdream.shadow_hand_note.page.2:
To those who come after: I hope my shameful experience can contribute something to your exploration.

Unless you possess the power to roam this bleak and terrifying world without fear of any threat, please, never go near where "the Eye" resides.
book.pasterdream.shadow_hand_essay.title: An Essay on the Black Hands
After roughly finishing my exploration of every biome in this world, I came to understand almost all of its structures to a considerable degree...
...except for that "Eye" wrapped within four "fingers."
The glowing portal at its center seems to lead to a space that is simple in structure, yet far from safe.
To be on the safe side, I sent a sturdy machine fitted with an image-transmission device through the portal, letting it scout in my place.

After passing through the portal, it slowly descended to the center of what looked like an "arena."
The image began to grow blurry; the ground shook violently, and then two enormous black hands materialized out of thin air.
The moment they noticed this "foreign object" I had thrown through the portal, they immediately launched a fierce attack on it from both sides.
In the feed, one hand suddenly charged in and flipped the machine upside down; then, amid darkness and a blast of wind, the machine's vision went dark for good, and I lost contact with it.

No good—there are still too many variables with this approach. With information this thin, I have no chance of winning.
Even so, I'll leave this note behind anyway. Though it contains hardly any valuable information, it should still be of some help to those who come after.
book.pasterdream.shadow_hand_defeat.titl: The Final Battle with the Black Hands—and Defeat
book.pasterdream.shadow_hand_defeat.page:
I write this note as a warning to any traveler who dares challenge it: "It" is far more powerful than you can imagine.
As for what lies beyond that shimmering portal, the notes left by my friends and the other Dream-Seekers who explored the shadowlit realm gave me the answer: behind that door is a small, sealed-off world inhabited by a terrifying shadow creature shaped like a pair of hands.
To defeat it, I forged armor and weapons from the toughest metal obtainable in the Pink Dream, and after making every preparation I could think of,

I leaped into the portal.
Yet even though I believed I had prepared thoroughly, the battle was still brutally hard.
Endless shadow monsters surging from who-knows-where, along with the Black Hands' ferocious onslaught, wore down my spirit, my will, and my stamina without a moment's pause.
Even so, I attacked with everything I had, only to be met with even fiercer counterattacks—still, in any case, I believe I dealt it a heavy blow.

Just when I thought I might actually stand a chance of winning, something dreadful happened.
In an instant my vision was swallowed by darkness, and out of that pitch-black void countless shadow creatures seemed to writhe forth, while my attacks couldn't even pierce the thick layer of shadow surrounding those hands.
Surrounded by monsters, out of potions, and badly wounded, I prayed desperately in my mind that this was all just a dream—then I took the Pale Bone Needle and stabbed it hard into my own arm.

After a sharp pang of pain, my vision was flooded with blinding light. In the blink of an eye, I was back beside my familiar bed; but my body drenched in cold sweat, my armor riddled with cracks, and my potion bottles completely empty all told me that what had just happened was no mere dream.
As I thought—to defeat this dreadful creature, I need a weapon that can suppress the shadow, or one that can merge into the shadow and destroy it from within.
So I really had overlooked something... Perhaps waiting for other allies to arrive
and facing it together with them would be a better

choice.
Until then, I must first find a more powerful weapon...
book.pasterdream.black_metal_research.pa:
To trace the origin of this research, I have to go back to some strange metal I discovered in this pitch-black dream.
It could be found in those hanging lanterns, in the ruins, or inside some pottery jars and treasure boxes.

It looked like iron in texture, but its rust wasn't a brown flaking layer—instead, it was dotted with many small black holes.
Smelting it in an ordinary furnace had no effect at all, so I just tossed it into lava—and unsurprisingly, it vaporized on the spot.

To study this metal, Yelan and I went looking for a rundown trapezoid-shaped house nearby.

But by a stroke of coincidence, liquid shadow seeping down from the second floor dripped into the jar holding these metals, and the shadow seemed to have a mind of its own, filling in those corroded holes.

"These aren't enough." "It seems these metals are merely a vessel—what's truly missing is the shadow itself."

As our research went on, the answer was: "high heat, flowing shadow, and the bodies of those shadow monsters."

We woke up back here, and carrying our materials and equipment, lay down once more on the bed beneath the shadow lantern...

With the roar of the machine—fusing, melting, condensing... at last, with a clatter, a piece of black metal fell to the ground...
book.pasterdream.shadow_cabin.title: Shadow Cabin
book.pasterdream.shadow_cabin.author: Jixing
book.pasterdream.shadow_cabin.page.2:
The native inhabitants here are gentle beetles; as long as you don't attack them, they'll leave you in peace.

While strolling through this forest, I happened upon a house.

Interestingly, the walls of this cabin seem to be made from the stalks of the fungal trees.
book.pasterdream.shadow_cabin.page.3:
After I peeled away the layer of shadow clinging to the surface of a stalk, I found its appearance was no different from the walls of the house — a material somewhat like... stripped logs?

This house seems to have been abandoned for a long time; the only traces of human life left are a few scattered carpets. Even the native beetles have made this cabin their home, and I had to shoo them away before I could inspect the interior carefully.
book.pasterdream.shadow_cabin.page.4:
Just as I was inspecting the floor of the house, I noticed several patches of unnatural shadow clinging to the boards.

I stood at a distance and lightly pressed one foot onto a patch of that shadow.

From beneath it, a hand made of shadow shot out, grabbed my foot, and tried to drag me underground. I struggled desperately and finally managed to pull my foot free from that shadowy grip.
book.pasterdream.shadow_cabin.page.5:
When I tried to sweep away another patch of shadow, it changed shape before vanishing, turning into the same hand-shaped monster I'd seen in the shadow-covered mountains. It took some real effort to cut it to pieces.

I have a feeling I'll run into this kind of “trap” again somewhere else...



By: Jixing
book.pasterdream.shadow_travels_2.title: Shadow Lamp Travels, Vol. 2
book.pasterdream.shadow_travels_2.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.shadow_travels_2.page.0:
I'm really curious — how do these fungi even manage to grow here?

The sky here holds no light, no familiar sun, no reliable source of energy.

Yet these fungi sink their roots into the black stone and grow into mushroom trees taller than a person, even bearing fruit that glows.
book.pasterdream.shadow_travels_2.page.1:
They've also nurtured some little creatures that might be native to this place. These beetles feed on the fungal cords here, living together in this place in large groups.

Facing the darkness, they've grown white eyes — perhaps that's what lets them see through it.

This “ecosystem” formed by these lives... well, modern science simply cannot explain it at all.
book.pasterdream.shadow_travels_2.page.2:
Though, from that pink-stained world to this pitch-black land crawling with monsters, none of it was ever something science could explain — it's all just illusory products of someone's subjective imagination.

Eh, I'm no researcher anyway. But still... these mushrooms... could they be tasty?

I think I should go study some recipes (and find myself a test subject!)
book.pasterdream.land_of_darkness.title: Land of Darkness
book.pasterdream.land_of_darkness.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.land_of_darkness.page.0:
No no no, this place... I can barely make out anything here. It feels like black mist is pressed right against my eyes!

“Yelan! Where are you? Can you hear me?”

This goes back to a few days ago — she was collecting herbs in that pink dream when she spotted a church half-soaked in black... I'm sure those of you reading this book have been through it too. She led me here as well.
book.pasterdream.land_of_darkness.page.1:
“I'll grab my gear and check out that phantom lamp first. Wait here a bit — if it's safe over there, I'll call you over.” “Mm.”

And then, the instant she touched the Shadow Lamp, it felt like a flood of black mist surged over, and I couldn't see a thing...

By the time the mist cleared... she was no longer near the lamp.
book.pasterdream.land_of_darkness.page.2:
So of course I ran over and touched the Shadow Lamp too — and that's how I ended up looking like this.

“Hey! Can you hear me?! You... are... AAAAAH... What the... Mmmph! (Let me go!)” “Shh! Keep quiet!”

“It's me (very quietly)” “What are you doing! That hurt! I felt like I'd fallen from the ground!”
book.pasterdream.land_of_darkness.page.3:
“Didn't you see all those freaky things out there? If you want to live, be careful.” “I don't think I can see them either (muttering quietly)”

“This is the shelter I built — well, actually, I'm borrowing someone else's tomb.” “Wha?!...” “Shh!” “Mm...”

“By the way, I'm surprised you followed me here. I never sent you a signal.” “Well, I was worried, so I just kept following.”
book.pasterdream.land_of_darkness.page.4:
“Kept following? It's been about three days already.” “Huh?”

And then... she told me the story of her time here... including this “grave mound.”

“I see...” But after thinking it over... I finally decided not to write these down for now.

There are too many vague things... I need to go and verify them carefully.
book.pasterdream.land_of_darkness.page.5:
(Because... under the candlelight... I couldn't see her shadow...)

By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.shadow_workshop.title: The Underground Shadow Workshop
book.pasterdream.shadow_workshop.author: Jixing
book.pasterdream.shadow_workshop.page.0:
Although this forest is relatively safe, I decided to build a workspace underground to completely keep the shadow creatures from bothering me.

Thanks to some supplies I brought from the Overworld, I could at least build a small room in the bedroom where I can shower — after all, swimming through great swaths of shadow always leaves you wanting to rinse off.

I've planted most of the plants I could find around this world into flower beds. It's a bit odd, I admit, but tending to these plants always relaxes me just a little.
book.pasterdream.shadow_workshop.page.1:
Among these gray-black plants, one that I've named the “Shadow Mushroom” stands out in particular — unlike the others, this mushroom seems to share properties with saplings: give it enough room to grow, and it will grow into the kind of fungal tree you see all over this forest. It seems the formation of this forest is closely tied to these mushrooms.
What's curious, though, is that this mushroom absolutely needs ample space to grow.
Last time I planted it in a flower bed, it suddenly went wild and wrecked the whole thing.
book.pasterdream.shadow_workshop.page.2:
To keep that from happening again, I moved it out of the flower bed and limited its growing space. (The fully grown fungal tree beside it I've left in place for further study.)
After endlessly tinkering with certain materials from this world, I finally managed to replicate the black long bed I used to come to this world. It seems that lying down on it would send me back to my original world.
But there are still so many unknowns in this world waiting for me to explore; until I've figured all of it out, I don't plan on easily returning to the
book.pasterdream.shadow_workshop.page.3:
Overworld.
Ah, looks like a beetle has crawled in. Although this kind of beetle isn't aggressive, I still don't like being disturbed by creatures. Time to go shoo it away.
book.pasterdream.floating_island_diary.p:
Say, how do you think these buildings and islands floating in the sky came to be?

Is it nature's masterwork? Or were there people who came here before us...

But then, stones and dirt shouldn't be able to fly, either. How could nature craft something so man-made, and how could humans construct all this beyond the bounds of reality.

Geez, the moment I seriously start thinking about this, the whole worldview I've built up over my life comes crumbling down.

But then again, there's no need to agonize over it. Maybe my gut feeling is right? It's all just a dream, after all.

Imagination knows no bounds — you could even make this island talk! Don't you think so~

But one day, I will come to understand all of this...

And I'll make this journey a memory I can never forget for the rest of my life.

By Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.between_dreams.title: Between Dreams
book.pasterdream.between_dreams.author: Liuhua
book.pasterdream.between_dreams.page.0:
To those who come after:

These words record what I have seen and heard here, along with some speculations. I do not know what this world truly is.
But (struck-out text) “miracle” — that is the only word I can use to describe the world before my eyes.

Pink everywhere, a sky that never darkens, and no loathsome evil festering in the dark. It is like a dream — no, perhaps it is a dream.
book.pasterdream.between_dreams.page.1:
Though I was raised under a materialist education, facing a scene that existing knowledge utterly fails to explain, I couldn't help but wonder:

Could there truly be something like gods in this world? (And would such a god be the idealist “deity,” or a higher “existence”?)

Still, there are no shortage of doubts here. Every thing carries its opposite within it.
book.pasterdream.between_dreams.page.2:
If such a beautiful world exists, then is there a place that is its exact opposite? Moreover, this world carries a strange sense of unreality everywhere — everything feels so real, and yet there's a vague detachment to it all (perhaps something like a lucid dream?).

Who created this miracle, and who sustains it (or oversees it?)?

(Large stretches of struck-out text)
book.pasterdream.between_dreams.page.3:
Perhaps someone once stayed here (or settled here?), after all there are objects full of the breath of life — a smoker, flower pots, bookshelves.

Yet the owner has likely been gone for a long time (curiously, most of the items are as good as new, and the flowers on the windowsill are even still alive)

As for this world, for now I shall call it the “Dream.”
book.pasterdream.between_dreams.page.4:
Further conclusions will require more exploration to be confirmed. Perhaps I need a more stable way to travel back and forth between reality and the “Dream.”

By Liuhua
book.pasterdream.morning_breeze.title: The Fresh Morning Breeze
book.pasterdream.morning_breeze.author: Qin Yumeng
book.pasterdream.morning_breeze.page.0:
This is the start of a new day, and the arrival of a new wind direction.

Accompanied by the chime of wind bells, the drift of falling feathers, and the sunlight rising from the east.

Wind is a gift bestowed upon this land. Sailing with the wind will aid our exploration, while going against it may grind our steps to a halt.

The wind not only guides the direction of our journey — it is also a special kind of key.
book.pasterdream.morning_breeze.page.1:
The wind only blows when a new direction arrives, and it can never be foretold by any means.

If you miss the morning wind's guidance, or if you stand beyond this dream where your body cannot feel it, the Weather Vane can cross the line between reality and dream to tell you the current wind direction.

And the treasures scattered across this land will be able to change how the wind affects us.
book.pasterdream.morning_breeze.page.2:
There are still many secrets of the wind... Perhaps the wind will reveal them to us at some time, some place.


By Qin Yumeng
